   1| ### 2.4 Front-ends and domain services
   2| 
   3| Tallowbrook sells through three front-ends. Each front-end belongs to one team and ships on its own
   4| schedule.
   5| 
   6| | Front-end | What it is |
   7| | :--- | :--- |
   8| | Web shop | the storefront; its pages are rendered on the server |
   9| | Mobile BFF | the backend-for-frontend of the iOS and Android apps |
  10| | Partner API | the public REST interface for marketplace partners |
  11| 
  12| Product data, prices and stock levels belong to the three domain services: Catalog service,
  13| Pricing service and Stock service. A front-end holds no business rule of its own; it asks the
  14| domain services.
  15| 
  16| #### 2.4.1 Calls
  17| 
  18| - **FS-1.** Each front-end calls each domain service directly over HTTP/JSON.
  19| - **FS-2.** There is no API gateway between them (decision D-7). A gateway was rejected because it
  20|   adds a network hop to every page view.
  21| - **FS-3.** Stock service calls Pricing service to price reserved items.
  22| - **FS-4.** The Admin console writes to Catalog service and Pricing service.
  23| - **FS-5.** Stock service imports the Warehouse feed, a nightly SFTP drop of stock levels.
  24| 
  25| #### 2.4.2 Limits
  26| 
  27| | Subject | Limit |
  28| | :--- | :--- |
  29| | Partner API | 100 requests/s per partner |
  30| | Web shop | caches catalog responses for 60 s |
  31| | Pricing service | answers within 80 ms at p99 |
  32| 
  33| A partner that exceeds its rate receives an error and retries later. Web shop and Mobile BFF have
  34| no rate limit of their own.
=== END docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ===
